name: aws
description: Inspect cloud resources, storage and costs through the official AWS MCP server

io.github.personaljarvis.post_install_hint_md: Grant AWSMCPSignInOAuthAccessPolicy and the service permissions your queries need. This connects through the Frankfurt endpoint. OAuth supports one account per connection; IAM still controls every operation. Cost queries need Cost Explorer permissions.
io.github.personaljarvis.longevity_note: AWS access lasts one hour and refresh is limited to a session of up to 12 hours; then sign in again.
